data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 is reported as GBP 1,581.9m. The report contains reserving notes and a claims development table, but a clear, extractable GROSS prior-year movement figure (movement in prior years' provision for claims outstanding) could not be unambiguously located in the legible parts of the provided images. No reliable gross prior-year release/strengthening amount was confidently determined from the available pages.
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction uncertainty: scanned images are low-resolution and rotated. I was able to locate the gross closing/opening claims outstanding total (2,068.0 total outstanding at 31/12/2016 and 1,581.9 at 31/12/2015  opening for 2016 = 1,581.9) on the Technical Reserves tables (page 32). I could not confidently locate a single clear GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) figure in the available images. Some narrative and P&L lines (claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years) are visible but these are P&L claims incurred lines and specifically excluded by the instructions. The segmental gross premium breakdown (required for gross_premium_mix) appears in the notes but was not legible enough to transcribe exact class names and amounts; therefore gross_premium_mix is left empty. A claims development (triangle) table appears present on page 32 but the numeric cells were not legible enough to extract a reliable triangle for automated prior-year development calculation. Where figures were taken, confidence levels are noted above.
